subject: Pop Star, Ballerina and Racer quality (owner verdict, DL-QA-06)
question: Direct owner request to analyse and redesign the weakest minigames; no question was asked.
decision: Pop Star, Ballerina and Racer are the weakest minigames, their current versions are very weak, and they must be completely rebuilt from the ground up; several other games in the set are superior. The Pop Star's note-memory echo is a usable mechanic even though its shell is poor. The specific redesigns are proposals awaiting the owner's answers; no new design, art or build is accepted.

subject: Pop Star rebuild core loop
question: Owner question Q1 in docs/handoffs/codex_minigame_rebuilds_2026-10-17/README.md section 6 (revision 1); the owner chose the default.
decision: Rebuild the Pop Star around the timed echo plus play-along choruses: the band plays a one-bar call and Roshan answers it on her drums in the next bar, with ribbon play-along choruses between verses.

subject: Pop Star rebuild song
question: Owner question Q2 in docs/handoffs/codex_minigame_rebuilds_2026-10-17/README.md section 6 (revision 1); the owner chose the default.
decision: Use a new concert arrangement of the existing Starlight Singalong first; use Iko Iko for the Day Two story only once its game-use rights are confirmed.

subject: Pop Star rebuild band
question: Owner question Q3 in docs/handoffs/codex_minigame_rebuilds_2026-10-17/README.md section 6 (revision 1); the owner chose the default.
decision: Daddy (ukulele) and Baby Eagle (bass) are the free-play Pop Star band.

subject: Ballerina rebuild concept
question: Owner question Q4 in docs/handoffs/codex_minigame_rebuilds_2026-10-17/README.md section 6 (revision 1); the owner chose the default.
decision: Rebuild the Ballerina as the music-box ballet: the child dances each step at her own pace on Roshan, whose animation lands on the beat; make-your-own-dance comes later as an encore.

subject: Racer rebuild view
question: Owner question Q5 in docs/handoffs/codex_minigame_rebuilds_2026-10-17/README.md section 6 (revision 1); the owner chose the default.
decision: Rebuild the Racer as the side-scrolling three-lane race (Reef Grand Prix) rather than a following camera over the existing painted circuit.
